name: Another Code: R Kioku no Tobira
original_name: アナザーコード: R 記憶の扉
source:
Set two years after the events of the previous game, a now 16-year-old Ashley is invited by her father to visit the campground of Juliet Lake. As the story progresses, Ashley attempts to find the truth about her mother's death.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Another_Code_R]Wikipedia[/url]]
